children: AeroVironment Inc reported first-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $480.49M, a 5.7% increase from the prior-year quarter, while the company posted a net loss of ($5.07M) and diluted loss per share of ($0.1). The results reflected higher product and service sales and improved gross margins versus the year-ago period.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Diluted loss per share”.
Revenue growth was driven by product sales (+$15.5M) and services (+$10.3M); the AeroVironment Solutions (AxS) channel grew 21%, supported by UAS demand (+$39.1M).
Space, Cyber & Directed Energy (SCDE) declined 21%, reflecting lower Space/Directed Energy and CMS services.
Gross margin improved to 26%, aided by lower amortization and reduced non-cash purchase accounting expenses.
Operationally, the company acquired a Southern California campus and reported a funded backlog of $1,457.8M and an unfunded backlog of $1,366.5M.
R&D spending moderated to about 5% of revenue this quarter, with planned increases in R&D and capex to support Space product commercialization.
